name: Isidora Sepúlveda
bio:
Isidora's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in engineering. While working on vehicle dynamics simulations for a local university, she was recruited by a small rally team seeking to improve their car's handling. She transitioned from simulation to real-world testing and grew to relish the challenge of translating data into actionable changes. Her meticulous approach and sharp eye for detail led her to coordinating test driver programs, ensuring that every aspect of testing is optimized for maximum data acquisition and performance improvement.

Now at Trident, Isidora brings a unique blend of technical expertise and management skill. She's known for her demanding nature, pushing test drivers and engineers alike to constantly refine their processes and deliver precise feedback. Her ability to identify subtle changes in vehicle behavior and communicate them effectively makes her a valuable asset in Trident's development program. She believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, always seeking new ways to leverage testing data to enhance performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave.
physical.description: Isidora is a woman of medium height with a commanding presence and sharp features.

quirks: Insists on using only metric measurements, even when others prefer imperial.
Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations, even during informal conversations.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on the table when deep in thought.
